description.en: b'AI'tcoin (BAIT) is a novel Layer-1 blockchain combining zero-knowledge Machine Learning Proof-of-Useful-Work (zkML-PoUW) with SHA-256d consensus. With a fixed supply of 21 million coins mirroring Bitcoin's scarcity, BAIT transforms AI computation into measurable mining value. The native bridge uses a Lock-and-Mint mechanism secured by a 3-of-5 multisig, enabling seamless ERC-20 (wBAIT) representation on Ethereum and EVM chains.

submission.project_description: b'AI'tcoin (BAIT) is a novel Layer-1 blockchain combining zero-knowledge Machine Learning Proof-of-Useful-Work (zkML-PoUW) with SHA-256d consensus. team.description: The b'AI'tcoin team combines expertise in blockchain engineering, zero-knowledge proofs, machine learning, and distributed systems. Core contributors are publicly identified on GitHub and the project governance page.

technical_highlights: Novel zkML-PoUW consensus - AI computation as proof-of-work
SHA-256d secondary consensus layer for Bitcoin-compatible security
Slither-audited smart contracts - LOW overall risk
21M fixed supply - Bitcoin-halving compatible emission schedule
Schnorr signature support for aggregate validation
submission.additional_notes: BAIT is the native token of the b'AI'tcoin blockchain, a Layer-1 network that reimagines proof-of-work by redirecting mining energy toward useful AI/ML computations. The wBAIT ERC-20 token on Ethereum provides DeFi composability via a secure Lock-and-Mint bridge. The project has been under active development since 2024 with a live testnet and mainnet launch planned for 2025.
